profile.name: Nithin Sivaraman
profile.headline: Aspiring nuclear engineering or physics student exploring fusion materials through simulation, building with CAD and CNC, and sharing science through community STEM education.
profile.school: The Academy for Math, Science, and Engineering
profile.bio: I'm a student at The Academy for Math, Science, and Engineering in Rockaway, New Jersey, interested in studying nuclear engineering or physics. Working with a professor on simulations involving cubic boron nitride in fusion materials research has given me a way to explore that interest beyond the classroom. In summer 2026, I completed Rutgers Honors Engineering eXperience (RHEx) and NC State University’s Young Investigators’ Summer Program in Nuclear Engineering. My preparation includes AP Physics C in mechanics and electricity and magnetism, AP Calculus BC, and practical experience designing assemblies in CAD and producing parts on CNC machines. I'm also interested in electrical and mechanical engineering as related paths for applying physics through design and fabrication. As founder and president of a community STEM club, I design hands-on lessons that connect science to things children can observe. Alongside this work, I sing, play saxophone and flute, and contribute to my community through music and service.
funFacts: Research: working with a professor on simulations involving cubic boron nitride for fusion materials research.
Summer 2026: earned certificates of completion for NC State’s nuclear engineering summer program and Rutgers Honors Engineering eXperience (RHEx).
Engineering: led catapult design and calibration as an event captain; one team catapult earned third place for accuracy at the 2025 NJAAPT Physics Olympics.
Service: helped raise more than $1,000 in toys for St. Joseph's Children's Hospital through Zooming thru Music.
Music: six years with the New Jersey Youth Chorus, with performances at Carnegie Hall, NJPAC, and MetLife Stadium.

achievements.title: NJAAPT Physics Olympics
achievements.organizer: New Jersey Association of Physics Teachers
achievements.description: Served as an event captain in the Modern Physics Club, leading a team in designing, building, and calibrating catapults for the 2025 NJAAPT Physics Olympics. One of our catapults earned third place for accuracy. My contribution centered on team coordination, construction, and calibration.

achievements.title: USBands New Jersey State Championships · Group IV A
achievements.description: Played saxophone in the marching band that earned second place in Group IV A at the 2025 USBands New Jersey State Championships. Participated throughout all four years of high school, rehearsing and performing coordinated music and movement with the ensemble.

projects.title: Fusion materials: cubic boron nitride
projects.summary: Research internship exploring cubic boron nitride through simulation.
projects.description: Working with a professor on simulations involving cubic boron nitride in fusion materials research. This ongoing internship connects my interest in studying nuclear engineering or physics with materials science and computational investigation.

projects.title: NC State: nuclear engineering summer program
projects.summary: Completed NC State University’s three-week Young Investigators’ Summer Program in Nuclear Engineering in July 2026.
projects.description: Attended the Young Investigators’ Summer Program in Nuclear Engineering at NC State University, July 6–24, 2026. The residential program’s curriculum included expert-led lectures and labs covering nuclear energy, radiation detection, nuclear security, waste management, and industrial plasmas, alongside a small-group project and industrial field trips. This experience complements my fusion materials research and my interest in studying nuclear engineering or physics. Received a certificate of completion.

projects.title: Rutgers Honors Engineering eXperience (RHEx)
projects.summary: Completed Rutgers School of Engineering’s residential summer program, June 28–July 3, 2026.
projects.description: Attended the Rutgers Honors Engineering eXperience (RHEx) in summer 2026. The one-week residential program introduces students to engineering disciplines through faculty-led workshops, hands-on activities, labs, and projects. Its curriculum spans materials science, aerospace, chemical, electrical, and mechanical engineering, including control systems and automation. This experience complements my interest in nuclear engineering and physics with exploration of related engineering fields. Received a certificate of completion.

projects.title: Catapult engineering & calibration
projects.summary: Event captain for a team whose catapult earned third place for accuracy.
projects.description: Led a group within the Modern Physics Club to design, construct, and calibrate catapults for the 2025 NJAAPT Physics Olympics. The work connected mechanics with a practical engineering task: building a device and calibrating it for accurate launches. One team catapult earned third place for accuracy.

projects.title: Community STEM: learning by doing
projects.summary: Founded a club and designed hands-on science lessons for children.
projects.description: Founded and lead a community STEM club that introduces children to science through hands-on experiences. I design lessons that connect scientific concepts with observable phenomena, giving students a concrete way to engage with what they are learning.

projects.title: CAD to CNC: design into fabrication
projects.summary: Designed assemblies and parts using Onshape, AutoCAD, and CNC equipment.
projects.description: Create assemblies in Onshape and designs in AutoCAD, then operate CNC machines to produce designed parts. This work connects digital design with physical fabrication and supports my interest in mechanical engineering as another path for applying physics.
